name: PBRTv4 BVH Layout
definition: A specific BVH memory layout used in PBRTv4, characterized by contiguous node arrays, implicit left-child pointers, unified interior/leaf data, and separate primitive storage.
summary: The PBRTv4 BVH Layout is a memory-efficient, cache-friendly BVH representation that replaces explicit pointers with implicit indexing in contiguous arrays to reduce pointer-chasing overhead.
